subject: Physical activity calculations in not complete days

messages.author: 10ed6cd2dc795058
messages.subject: Physical activity calculations in not complete days
parts:
Hi there,

i am using the GENEActiv accelerometer and would like to use the GGIR to analyse the raw data. For my study design exact start time for the measurement period is very important. It is defined as the point in time the patient returns from operating theatre to intensive care unit. So it starts mid day most of the time. Due to the wanted measurement frequency of 100 Hz, the GENEActiv can only record 7 days of data. 
Now, if I want to calculate the physical activity, e.g. time spent in moderate physical activity, for the last day of the measurement the GGIR package never shows any data for that day. Most of time measurement period ends around 3 pm, so patient have a lot of hours to move. I set the parameter for valid hours of a day to 0 but this does not fix my problem. Is there any solution for that? 

I am looking forward hearing from you and thank you in advance for your help.

Kind regards,

Sebastian Schmidt

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Physical activity calculations in not complete days
parts:
Did you check argument minimum_MM_length.part5?

However, please note that it is intentionally 23 hours by default as deriving time in intensity levels for an incomplete day cannot be compared with time spent in intensity levels for a complete day. It could skew your results if not considered carefully.

Kind regards,

Vincent
